exposure: Type of equipment used for resuscitation
Location of birthing unit (metropolitan vs. nonmetropolitan)
outcome: Availability of trained personnel for neonatal resuscitation
cohort: Birth attendants in 103 nontertiary birthing units in New South Wales and Australian Capital Territory
finding: Equipment and availability of trained personnel for neonatal resuscitation in nontertiary birthing units across NSW and ACT vary widely, with variable resources for training and education.
